title: Lesson 6: When an Agent Is the Right Tool, and When to Say No
description: The honest consultant's rule: an agent is not always the right answer, and the consultant who can say no protects both the client's money and their own reputation. How to tell the work an agent should do from the work it should never touch, and how to walk away cleanly.
